description: This file defines the AppDatabase class using Room ORM for an Android app. It specifies the database entities, DAOs, singleton instantiation, and type converters for managing local storage of calendar events, leaves, and astrology data.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: An abstract class extending RoomDatabase that provides access to DAOs and manages the database instance.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of AppDatabase, creating it if necessary, using the application context.
